title: Vision Transformer Ensembles for Panoramic Street Segmentation
abstract: arXiv:2610.06063v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Semantic segmentation of street panoramas can support detailed descriptions of urban environments, yet small datasets and unequal training costs make model selection difficult. This paper documents the two stages of a submission to the PalmCity challenge. In the first stage, nine pretrained segmentation systems are compared using approximately equal computation budgets, and the two leading candidates are trained with three random seeds. An equal probability average of three Encoder only Mask Transformer models with DINOv3 features, evaluated at three image scales with horizontal reflection, reaches 60.95% mean intersection over union on the 84 image validation split and 57.08% on the hidden test leaderboard, first in the snapshot of 5 October 2026. translated_title: 用于全景街道分割的视觉Transformer集成方法
translated_abstract: 街道全景图像的语义分割能够为城市环境的详细描述提供支持，然而小规模数据集和不均衡的训练成本使得模型选择变得困难。本文记录了参加PalmCity挑战赛提交方案的两个阶段。在第一阶段，在近似相等的计算预算下比较了九种预训练分割系统，并用三个随机种子训练了两个表现领先的候选模型。将三个基于DINOv3特征的纯编码器掩码Transformer模型进行等概率平均集成，并在三个图像尺度上结合水平翻转进行评估，在84张图像的验证集上达到了60.95%的平均交并比，在隐藏测试排行榜上达到57.08%，在2026年10月5日的快照中排名第一。在第二阶段，在相同的更新预算下测试了颜色与裁剪数据增强、稀有类别采样、更大的输入尺寸、更多架构以及后处理方法，并对候选...（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文在PalmCity全景街道分割挑战赛中，通过在近似相同计算预算下对比九种预训练分割模型，并将三个基于DINOv3特征的纯编码器掩码Transformer模型以多尺度加水平翻转的方式进行等概率集成，最终以57.08%的隐藏测试集mIoU排名第一。
en_tdlr: This paper compares nine pretrained segmentation systems under equal computation budgets and ensembles three Encoder-only Mask Transformer models with DINOv3 features, evaluated at three scales with horizontal flipping, achieving first place with 57.08% mIoU on the hidden test leaderboard of the PalmCity panoramic street segmentation challenge.
